name: NecroCode 3D Exorcism Hooks
description: Kiro-native trigger hooks for the haunted 3D code-exorcism ritual. Maps backend SSE phases to frontend Ritual UI states and drives the React Three Fiber seals, aura, terminal, and stereo-panned synthesized SFX.

hooks.name: on-save-lint
hooks.description: Run lint and typecheck after save to keep the Kiro build green.

hooks.name: on-run-start
hooks.description: Fires when the user summons the exorcism. Resets the 3D seals/logs, sets the relic to channelling purple, and opens the POST SSE stream.

hooks.name: on-corrupted-code
hooks.description: Binds the cursed artifact, reveals the masked syntax skeleton, and lights the Corrupted Code seal.

hooks.name: on-spectral-scan
hooks.description: Runs the deterministic scanner across the real snippet and streams findings into the grimoire log while the scanner seal spins.

hooks.name: on-bug-detected
hooks.description: A real corruption was found: the Spectral Scanner seal turns crimson, the central relic heartbeat accelerates, and the bug-count badge appears.

hooks.name: on-kiro-reasoning
hooks.description: The Kiro Exorcism Reasoning seal spins its rings and streams each counter-sigil applied to the artifact.

hooks.name: on-fix-applied
hooks.description: A safe fix landed: the seal flashes neon, the flowing edge orb advances, and the progress bar climbs.

hooks.name: on-purified-output
hooks.description: Streams the purified artifact line-by-line to the grimoire and exposes one-click copy/download of the full finalCode.

hooks.name: on-run-complete
hooks.description: The ritual seals. All 3D nodes become neon green unless unresolved findings keep the scanner crimson; the relic resolves to green, or remains crimson for residual corruption.

hooks.name: on-reset
hooks.description: Clears the 3D selection, resets all seals to dormant, returns the relic aura to idle purple, and empties the grimoire.
